violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: Sour cream=51F, chicken Caesar wrap=47F,
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. COPRRECTED DURING THYE INSPECTION.

violations.title: When to Wash
violations.observation: A food employee failed to wash his or her hands before engaging in food preparation, after touching bare human body parts, after coughing, sneezing, eating, after handling soiled utensils, or after engaging in any activity that could contaminate the hands. Observed employees not washing hands between changing gloves during task changes.
violations.corrective_action: ALL food employees shall wash their hands OFTEN especially after handling trash, using the restroom, handling raw meats, handling soiled equipment and utensils, BEFORE putting on clean gloves, etc. Proper handwashing frequencies will aid in the reduction of foodborne illness. Corrected thru instruction.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Signage
violations.observation: Observed that sign or poster that notifies food employees to wash their hands is not provided or is not clearly visible at all handwashing sinks used by food employees at the following locations: bar, bistro, memory care, & two in assisted living. Advise labelling dump sink at bar as a dump sink for clarification purposes.
violations.corrective_action: Provide a visible sign or poster at all handwashing sinks used by food employees that reminds food employees to wash their hands. Signs posted during inspection.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: observed raw tuna in container over portions of mixed fruit in BevAir 1DR UR (unit #4)
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. Corrected by CFM

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal Foods Different Types
violations.observation: Different types of raw animal foods stored in such a manner that may cause cross contamination as follows: observed raw chicken held over raw beef in BevAir 1DR UR (unit #9).
violations.corrective_action: Raw animal foods shall be sorted by their 'type' and cooking temperatures while in storage inside a refrigerator or freezer. For example, if using ONE shelving unit for storage of ONLY raw foods, the foods shall be sorted in this manner: 1) raw poultry (chicken, turkey, or duck) shall be stored on the BOTTOM shelf (165F cook temperature), 2) raw ground beef and ground pork shall be stored on the shelf above poultry (155F cook temperature), and 3) raw pork (chops, ribs), seafood, and shell eggs shall be stored on the top shelf above beef (145F cook temperature). Corrected by CFM

violations.title: Hot Water Sanitizing Temperature Met
violations.observation: Due to improper operation of the hot water, mechanical warewashing machine, the high register dish thermometer did not reach 160F, indicating that food-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils are not being adequately sanitized.
violations.corrective_action: Immediately discontinue use of the dishmachine. Repair the dishmachine so that a thermolabel will turn black. Until the machine is adequately repaired, set up the 3 vat sink to manually wash, rinse and chemically sanitize food-contact surfaces. Dish was sanitized at triple sink until unit was repaired during inspection.

violations.title: (2017) Non-Continuous Cooking Written Procedures
violations.observation: The following raw animal foods were not prepared and stored according to written procedures: observed salmon raw in the middle with grill marks on top and bottom in BevaAir 1DR UR (unit #9).
violations.corrective_action: Raw animal foods that were cooked using a non-continuous cook process shall be prepared and stored according to written procedures that have obtained approval from the regulatory authority, are maintained in the food establishment and are available to the regulatory authority upon request, describe hot the requirements are to be monitored and documented and corrective actions taken, describe how the foods are to be marked as foods that must be further cooked, describe how the foods are to be separated from ready-to-eat foods. CFM discarded fish and has elected to discontinue non-continuous cooking in facility.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: mashed potato (70F) in hot hold cabinet on service line.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. CFM discarded mashed potatoes. THE VIRGINIAN (Inspection Date: 02/06/2026) Page 3 of 6

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: anchovy, feta and blue cheese (47F) in BevAir prep (unit #8).
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CFM discarded TCS items in unit and lowered equipment temperature of unit from 48F to 38F by covering prep top with lid.

out_items.name: Consumer advisory provided for raw and undercooked food

violations.title: Consumer Advisory for Raw/Undercooked Food
violations.observation: A review of the menu with the foodservice operator indicates that there is no consumer advisory for the following food item(s) that may be served raw and/or undercooked: tuna and porterhouse steak on independent living (Stonehouse and Bistro) menu.
violations.corrective_action: If an animal food such as beef, eggs, fish, lamb, milk, pork, poultry, or shellfish is served or sold raw or undercooked the permit holder shall inform consumers of the significantly increased risk of consuming such foods by way of a disclosure and reminder using brochures, deli case or menu advisories, label statements, table tents, placards, or other effective written means. Please email inspector a draft of the revised menu to review before printing.

violations.title: Consumer Advisory for Raw/Undercooked Food, Disclosure
violations.observation: The following raw and/or undercooked foods are provided on the menu, menu board, table tent or brochure without proper disclosure: tuna and porterhouse steak on independent living (Stonehouse and Bistro) menu.
violations.corrective_action: The Consumer Advisory shall include a disclosure statement that includes a description of the animal-derived foods as raw/undercooked or identification of the animal-derived foods by asterisking (*) them to a footnote that states that the items are served raw or undercooked, or contain raw or undercooked ingredients. Please email inspector a draft of the revised menu to review before printing.

out_items.name: Proper cooling methods used; adequate equipment for temperature control

violations.title: Methods to Facilitate Cooling in Equipment
violations.observation: The following methods used for cooling were not adequate to facilitate proper cooling: Cut lettuce and cut melon placed in large/deep containers and covered placed in refrigerators for same day use.
violations.corrective_action: Cooling hot foods shall be accomplished as follows: 1) placing the food in shallow pans; 2) separating the food into smaller or thinner portions; 3) using rapid cooling equipment; 4) stirring the food in a container placed in an ice water bath; 5) using containers that facilitate heat transfer; 6) adding ice as an ingredient; or other effective methods. Food containers placed in cooling and cold equipment to cool shall be: 1) arranged in the equipment to provide maximum heat transfer through the containers walls, and 2) loosely covered or uncovered as long as protected from contamination to facilitate heat transfer from the surface of the food. Corrected thru instruction. CFM instructed employee to move items to shallow pans in WIC until items reached 41F and then moved to containers.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: salt, oil and water in containers at front prep line.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. CFM removed containers and instructed employee to label.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage Clean and Dry Location
violations.observation: Food stored in a wet or soiled location as follows: food goods held in boxes on floor in dry storage
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food in a clean, dry location.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: mixed utensils at service line in pot of still water in service sink.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. CFM turned faucet on to run water into pot THE VIRGINIAN (Inspection Date: 02/06/2026) Page 4 of 6

out_items.name: Utensils, equipment and linens properly stored, dried and handled

violations.title: Equipment/Utensils Air Drying
violations.observation: Food bins were found stacked while wet after cleaning and chemical sanitization.
violations.corrective_action: After cleaning and sanitizing, equipment and utensils shall be air-dried or used after adequate draining before contact with food. Employees unstacked nested bins. THE VIRGINIAN (Inspection Date: 02/06/2026) Page 5 of 6

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items, Stored off Floor, Clean Location
violations.observation: Observed that clean single use utensils in dry storage and glassware at Bistro were stored on the floor in an manner that exposed the item(s) to contamination.
violations.corrective_action: Store clean equipment, utensils, and linens in a clean, dry location where they are not exposed to splash, dust, or other contamination and at least 6 inches above the floor.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: conveyor high temp sanitizing dish machine (EC44CW) sanitizing water temperature less than 180F resulting in dish surface temperature less than 160F.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. Repaired during inspection

violations.title: Fixed Equipment, Properly Spaced and Sealed
violations.observation: The following equipment is not installed in a manner that allows accessibility for cleaning, nor is it installed with closely abutting surfaces to minimize the need for cleaning: stainless steel prep table at dessert mounted tight to wall by bracket not sealed between wall and counter top.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment that is fixed because it is not easily movable shall be installed so that it is: 1) spaced to allow access for cleaning along the sides, behind, and above the equipment, 2) spaced from adjoining equipment, walls, and ceilings a distance of not more than 1 millimeter or one thirty-second inch, and 3) sealed to adjoining equipment or walls if the equipment is exposed to spillage or seepage. Advise replacing bracket and mounting from under table and sealing table top to wall if prep table is not able to be pulled from the wall during cleaning.

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Observed the lack of an approved backflow prevention device on the water supply system.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. Corrected thru instruction. Disconnect chemical dispensing system from mop sink faucet immediately. Replace splitter with wasting tee or pressure reducing splitter before reconnecting chemical dispensing system.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Mops Allowed to Air Dry
violations.observation: Observed that mops are improperly stored between use - not hung to dry.
violations.corrective_action: Store mops in a position that allows them to air dry without soiling walls, equipment, or supplies.

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Observed that the following are not maintained in good repair: light bulb burned out under hood, depression in floor at dish area where floor sealant is missing exposing concrete - pooling water.
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities.

violations.title: Floors/Walls/Ceilings, Smooth, Easily Cleanable
violations.observation: Floor, floor covering, walls, wall covering, and ceiling is not designed, constructed or installed to be smooth and easily cleanable. Observed ceiling panel out of place and holes for utility lines in dry storage, perforated non-washable ceiling tile in dry storage and dish area.
violations.corrective_action: Floor, floor covering, walls, wall covering, and ceiling must be designed, constructed and installed to be smooth and easily cleanable.

out_items.name: Adequate ventilation and lighting, designated areas used

violations.title: Ventilation Hood, Designed to Prevent Condensate Drip
violations.observation: Condensation from the exhaust hood system in the warewashing area was observed dripping onto food-contact surfaces below.
violations.corrective_action: Exhaust ventilation hood systems in food preparation and warewashing areas including components such as hoods, fans, guards, and ducting shall be designed to prevent grease or condensation from draining or dripping onto food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: beef gravy=47F, Red Wine reduction=47F, Saffron cream =49F, Egg salad=47F, spinach cream sauce=48F.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. AlLL DISCARDED DURING THE INSPECTION.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food, Disposition
violations.observation: Observed the following ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food being held for more than the specified time/temperature allowed: A variety of prepared sauces were observed held in thew walk-in refrigerator , past 7 days after prep dates.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be discarded if it: 1) exceeds 7 days or at 41F (except the time it is frozen); or 2) is in a container or package that does not bear a date or day. Regularly check prep foods dates to ensure proper beholding periods , not exceeding 7 days. ALL DISCARDED DURING THE INSPECTION. THE VIRGINIAN (Inspection Date: 10/09/2025) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Jewelry
violations.observation: Employees observed wearing jewelry on their arms and hands while preparing food. Food handlers were observed wearing bracelets, and watches on their hands/arms while handling food in food preparation areas.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees shall limit their jewelry to a plain wedding ring while preparing food. Food employees may not wear bracelets, watches, etc. because they can inhibit proper hand washing.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment are not operating properly and/or in poor repair: VICTORY HOT HOLDING BOX, located in the kitchen, and the COLD DISPLAY CASE, used for holding salads, located at the bistro station.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. DO NOT USE THESE EQUIPMENT UNTIL THEY HAVE BEEN FIXED AND WORKING PROPERLY.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Wash Temp for Hot Water Warewashing Machines
violations.observation: The wash water temperature of the hot water sanitizing warewashing machine at the BISTRO STATION is not meeting the manufacturer's specifications. The minimum temperature was @ 150F while the actual temperature was 131F
violations.corrective_action: The temperature of the wash solution in spray type warewashers that use hot water to sanitize may not be less than: 1) 165F for a stationary rack, single temperature machine, 2) 150F for a stationary rack, dual temperature machine, 3) 160F for a single tank, conveyor, dual temperature machine, or 4) 150F for a multitank, conveyor, multitemperature machine.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed that the floor inside the walk-in. Refrigerator is in need of cleaning. Also, the floor drains in the kitchen are in need of cleaning.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food.
